Graph lets only Entra directory roles read or write app creation policies: an app holding every policy permission gets 403 (Q256), and KEEL does not give its restore app a directory role for this; a difference is set by hand

recreated through Exchange Online PowerShell by the exchange-role-definitions workload restore (a role that is gone only, off until live-qualified); an existing role is never changed, and built-in roles are Microsoft-managed
Graph has no write for Defender app access scopes (list only; create, update and delete are Exchange only)
the binding is made by signing in to Google; no tool can make it from a backup

issue #1074: uploading a code signing certificate makes devices trust every app it signs; a restore never writes a certificate (the trust-field rule)
the certificate file and its password are secrets and are not backed up

KEEL choice, issue #1075: a configuration is only the list of certificate authorities (trustedCertificateAuthorities, their public certificates and whether each is a root) that apps named in an app management policy trust for certificate sign-in; that list is a trust field a restore never writes (CLAUDE.md restore-writer rule), and an empty configuration would trust nothing, so the configuration and its authorities are created again by hand (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/certificatebasedapplicationconfiguration?view=graph-rest-beta)

KEEL choice, issue #1071: Graph beta creates a connector only with its connectionInfo, which holds how it signs in to SAP (client id, token address, Key Vault secret); a restore never writes sign-in settings, so the connector is created again by hand (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/entitlementmanagement-post-externaloriginresourceconnectors?view=graph-rest-beta)

KEEL choice, issue #1072: a PIM custom extension is only the call to its Logic App: Graph creates one only with its endpointConfiguration (the Logic App and its trigger address, which can hold an access key) and authenticationConfiguration (how Entra signs in to it), which a restore never writes, and the backup does not hold the Logic App address; updating the name and description alone would restore nothing that makes it work, so the extension is set up again by hand with the same Logic App (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/customcalloutextension?view=graph-rest-1.0)

Microsoft limit, issue #1072: Graph has no write for this list; Entra brings a group under Privileged Identity Management by itself when the group gets its first eligible or time-bound member or owner through PIM for Groups, and KEEL does not back up those PIM group assignments (their requests are not configuration), so there is no PIM eligibility path for groups to restore it through; a person adds an eligible member in PIM again (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/privilegedaccessgroup-overview?view=graph-rest-beta)
no writer yet; beta only

issue #1074: Graph's update documents only the vendor fields, not the state and reason an admin sets, so they are set again by hand
